notes: Printed names: 'GUY', 'FAIRVIEW AV.', 'CLIFTON AV.', 'CALHOUN', 'W. CLIFTON AV.', 'W. McMILLAN'; suffix-less names written with 'Street'. Guy jogs twice. The 60' piece between McMillan and Fairview is written 'Guy Street (north of McMillan)' to match sheets 251 and 258 (251 shows Guy south of McMillan one street width further west, so Guy/McMillan is a T). At Fairview it jogs again: south of Fairview it is 60' (lines x~285/640 at Fairview, x~341/702 at McMillan - the same street whose west line is on 258's right edge), north of Fairview it is 40' (lines x~495/745) with its centre ~178 px further east; two T points on Fairview, the north piece named 'Guy Street (north of Fairview)' (same convention as Cook/Heywood/Dennis). The north piece runs to the edge of the mapped area at y~1005 (sheet 278 above); no end recorded. Fairview Avenue (60') comes in from 258 and ends at Clifton (T); east of Clifton is Burnet Woods. Clifton Avenue is 100' north of Calhoun (lines x~3200-3222 / ~3803-3830) and 80' south of it (lines x~3225/3712); the west line is continuous, so the centre shifts ~60 px west at Calhoun; the Calhoun point uses the mean. Calhoun (50') runs east from Clifton (T) onto 260. West Clifton Avenue is at the right edge: only its west line (x~6111) is drawn; the centre is taken from the printed 72' (+220 px, x~6331, ~100 px inside the paper edge, where the page curls into the gutter). North of Calhoun the Calhoun-front block (328-322) runs across its line, so it ends at Calhoun (T); it continues south across McMillan. West McMillan's north line is at y~7391-7420; its centre is taken from the north line plus the printed 60' (~7577-7604; the water pipe runs ~50 px north of that); the paper ends at ~7720-7745. Clifton/McMillan is a T: sheet 252 shows block 2 continuous across Clifton's line south of McMillan. 'BOWLING ALLEYS' in block 4 is a building, not an alley. INSET: the upper right panel inside the heavy double frame (x>~3870, y<~5000) is the detached University of Cincinnati panel, drawn here but actually standing inside Burnet Woods Park ('325' TO STREET LINE' from Clifton); it contains only dashed park drives (a drive along its top and down its west side), no street intersections, so nothing in this file has part 'inset'. 'BURNET WOODS PARK' is printed both inside the panel and along the strip north of block 3 (Calhoun-front lots).
